name: Promo SAVE10 actually lowers the total
description: Applying SAVE10 must change the discount and total, not only show a message.

planSteps.description: On the shop page, click "Add to cart" for Serving Platter once
Click the Cart link in the store header
Type SAVE10 into the Promo code field and click Apply
The Shipping row reads $6.00 and the Total row reads exactly $47.40
